subject: CAIQ consolidation playbook, owner rally & evidence delivery timeline
messages:
From: Halcyon Health <halcyon-sec@halcyonhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: KPMG Auditor <auditor+kpmg@kpmg.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ: request for consolidated control mapping & evidence handoff

Priya,

Thanks for agreeing to help Halcyon Health with the CSA CAIQ package. We're consolidating control mappings for our procurement review and need a single bundle that includes:

- Completed CAIQ spreadsheet with cross-references to Redwood controls
- Owner roster (who to contact per control/subcontrol)
- Representative runtime logs and deployment artifacts (anonymized)
- Any attestations or design narratives for multi-tenant isolation

Can you confirm who on your side will own the controls (technical vs compliance) and provide an ETA for a consolidated package? The procurement team is targeting Sept 24 for submission to our security committee. If you have a tentative handoff plan that would help.

Thanks,

Marcus Hale
Director, Security Operations
Halcyon Health
halcyon-sec@halcyonhealth.com

Attachment: procurement_requirements_summary.pdf (stub)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Halcyon Health <halcyon-sec@halcyonhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ: request for consolidated control mapping & evidence handoff

Marcus,

Appreciate the clear list. We can deliver a consolidated CAIQ bundle by Sept 22 to leave a two-day buffer. Proposed playbook below — please confirm if that meets your timelines:

1) Today (Sept 12) — kickoff & owner roster: Kimberly will confirm control stewards and contact points.
2) Sept 13–16 — evidence harvest sprint: owners extract logs, design docs, and attestation notes.
3) Sept 17 — internal review and redaction (Jordan to provide anonymized runtime log template).
4) Sept 18–20 — QA and assembly of the CAIQ spreadsheet and narrative index.
5) Sept 21 — deliver initial bundle to Halcyon for review.
6) Sept 22 — final handoff (zip + signed cover letter).

Attachments we'll include: caIQ_control_map_v1.xlsx, owner_roster_v2.csv, runtime_log_sample.txt. If that looks good, Kimberly/Kelly will assign owners and Jordan will own log samples.

Thanks,

Priya Natarajan
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0142

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Halcyon Health <halcyon-sec@halcyonhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 14:20:45 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ: request for consolidated control mapping & evidence handoff

Priya / Marcus,

Confirming owners for the initial harvest sprint (technical owner / compliance owner):

- CCM-1 (Identity & Access): Marcus Lee / Priya Natarajan
- CCM-2 (Network & Perimeter): Jordan Blake / Kimberly Park
- CCM-3 (Data at rest / encryption): Sanjay Rao / Priya Natarajan
- CCM-4 (Runtime isolation / multi-tenant): Jordan Blake / Kimberly Park

Jordan — can you snapshot the last 7 days of anonymized token-level telemetry and a 24-hour runtime trace and add to the runtime_log_sample.txt stub in Drive? I'll assign owners in the roster and push updates to the shared folder.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cCAIQfold (access: redwood-caiq-team)

Kimberly Park
Director, Solutions Security
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Halcyon Health <halcyon-sec@halcyonhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ: request for consolidated control mapping & evidence handoff

Kim / Priya — thanks. I'm on it.

I'll upload:
- runtime_log_sample.txt (anonymized token IDs, time window, redacted user IDs)
- extraction_manifest.json (list of log IDs and retention proof)

ETA: initial files in Drive by EOD Sept 13 PST; final QA-ready bundle by Sept 21 as Priya outlined.

HubSpot: Deal RDW-2026-1887 (contact: Marcus Hale). DocuSign will be used for the signed cover letter.
